Cookie Policy.

We explain which storage technologies this website currently uses and how they may change in the future.

Effective date: November 9, 2026Paraguay
On this page
What they areCurrent useNecessary technologiesThird partiesHow to manage themChanges

1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files a website may store in the browser. Similar technologies, such as local or session storage, can also remember technical information during browsing.

2. Current use on the public website

The public ARANDU DEV institutional website currently does not use analytics, advertising, commercial tracking or behavioral profiling cookies. We display an informational notice to explain this and record the selected preference.

3. Strictly necessary technologies

Hosting and security infrastructure may use temporary identifiers or technical logs to deliver the website, detect malicious traffic and maintain availability. We store the preference selected in the cookie notice in the browser’s local storage. The private area uses session storage to temporarily maintain authenticated access; this function is not activated during a normal visit to the public website.

4. Third-party services

Cloudflare participates in website delivery and protection, while Supabase provides database and authentication services for specific functions. Each provider maintains its own privacy and security policies.

Links to external websites do not install cookies from ARANDU DEV; when opened, the destination website’s policies apply.

5. How to manage storage

You can review, block or delete cookies and website data in your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary technologies may affect authenticated areas or security measures.

6. Future changes

If we add analytics, personalization or advertising that requires consent, we will update this policy and enable the corresponding controls before activating those technologies.

Privacy or cookie inquiries: contacto@arandudev.com.
